structured.answer: I haven't decided anything. I'll ask my son and then the bank. The page only explains what each kind of saving is called. It doesn't say whether anything safe pays more than my deposit or what the bank takes, and the only safe-sounding thing I found was "איגרות חוב ממשלתיות".

stuck.where: Screen 2 top, the cards under 'כסף שוטף וקצר'
stuck.why: The page had scrolled past the card titles; only the bottom ends were visible ('הבנק משלם עליו ריבית', 'בריבית מוסכמת'), so I couldn't tell which one was the deposit.
After government bonds every card was 'מדד' with English letters (MSCI, S&P 500). It felt like shares and gambling, and I got tired and worried here.
The starting points are קרן השתלמות and pension, which are for salaried workers. Nothing there was for someone retired with deposits.

What the bank charges (עמלה) on deposits or savings plans
A clear sentence on what is as safe as a deposit but pays more

findings.what: Nothing answers whether something as safe as a deposit gives more, and there are no rates or fees anywhere
Grey text on a black background, and the small lines are very hard to read even enlarged
findings.where: Subtitles under headings, the 'בכל עמוד של מוצר' line, card descriptions

findings.what: Most of the investment section is English letters and 'מדד', which frightens off someone used to deposits
The deposit cards (כסף שוטף וקצר) slid past, and I only saw their bottom lines
'מאיפה להתחיל' only suits salaried workers, with nothing for retirees
I don't know who runs the site, and 'אתר אישי' doesn't make me trust it with money decisions
The second line already uses מק"מ, קרן כספית and מדד מניות without explaining them
